examples.label: Another parabola
examples.scope: Unique global minimum; D''=3x²+4 > 0 and D tends to infinity.

examples.label: Two equal minima
examples.scope: Both global minima are reported. Newton at zero instead returns a local maximum.

examples.label: Exponential
examples.scope: Unique global minimum; D''=2+4e^(2x) > 0 and D tends to infinity at both ends.

examples.label: Logarithm
examples.scope: Unique global minimum on x > 0; D'' >= 2-e^(-3) > 0 and D diverges at both domain ends.

examples.label: Reciprocal
examples.scope: Unique global minimum on the positive branch. The negative branch is excluded; it has an equally close point at (-1,-1).
